title: Multiplexed perturbation enables scalable pooled screens
contrast: CD54-low vs CD54-high sort, MOI 0.3, paired by replicate (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: ICAM1 (positive control) and new ICAM-1 regulators
barcs_calls: 1,533 genes at model FDR 0.10 (unreliable); 65 elements, including ICAM1 and TRAF6, lie beyond all 1,026 non-targeting guides, but the control null cannot reach FDR 0.10 with one guide per element
verdict: BARCS recovers the ICAM1 positive control (#7) with TRAF6, an NF-kB activator of ICAM1, at #4; both lie beyond every non-targeting guide. Non-targeting guides reproduce between replicates here, so the model FDR (1,533 genes) is unreliable, and one guide per element leaves the control null too coarse to set an FDR; the ranking is the usable result.
